text:
incident-bot: PAGER — auth-proxy: anomalous auth traffic spike detected (eu-west-1). 401/403 rate ~15x baseline, repeated session IDs, evidence of tokens seen in public debug logs bucket. Possible credential re-use + log leakage. Auto-created investigation thread INC-2026-312345. Severity: P2 (possible customer impact).

sam (oncall): I'm taking lead. Thanks for the alert. Quick checklist: does anyone have a list of affected service tokens or IP ranges? I'll start triage and coordinate mitigations.

leah (security): copying initial findings: suspicious IPs: 35.199.12.0/24 and 52.210.77.128/25 (sigs low confidence). Sample log line shows Authorization header exposed in debug log stream: `Authorization: Bearer svc_token_AbC123...` — looks like a stage-to-prod logging misconfig.

jon (platform): I can confirm we saw increased 401s from the proxy with same session_id prefix `sess-4f7*`. Rate-limiter kicked in but some requests still got through. Adding temporary rate limit at LB for the patterns now.

sam (oncall): Immediate mitigations I'm applying now: 1) revoke suspicious service tokens (target list below) 2) apply IP block/WAF rule for the top offending ranges 3) enable honeypot route to capture malicious payloads 4) move debug log stream to quarantine S3 prefix and reduce retention.

sam (oncall): Token revoke commands (running):
```bash
# revoke by id
redwoodctl auth token revoke --id svc-token-84217 --force
redwoodctl auth token revoke --id svc-token-9f3b2 --force
# confirm
redwoodctl auth token list --filter "status:revoked"
```

nicole (infra): I'm creating a quarantined bucket and locking access to security team + oncall. New path: s3://redwood-incident-quarantine/3123456789/ — will copy the flagged logs there and remove public permissions. Also spinning up a short-lived flow to capture full request payloads to a private kinesis stream.

leah (security): We need a coordinated key rotation plan for svc-proxy keys. Proposal: generate new keys in KMS, deploy to dedicated pools, perform canary rollout (5% traffic), validate, then global rotate. Shorten TTL during rollout to limit exposure. I can run the rotation if ops approves.

jon (platform): Plan sounds good. I'll add a rollout plan to the infra pipeline: patch config map, rolling restart of proxy pods by pool. Command I will run:
```bash
kubectl set image deploy/proxy svc-proxy=registry/redwood/proxy:rotated-keys-20260315
kubectl rollout status deploy/proxy -w
```
We'll keep one pool pinned until validation done.

ali (cust-success): Heads up — two enterprise customers in eu-west reported auth failures ~18:02 UTC. I'm drafting an incident-facing message and will start outreach to the account owners. ETA for a customer note to go out: 30m, unless we can narrow impacted endpoints sooner.

sam (oncall): Update: WAF rules applied, two tokens revoked (see logs). We've quarantined the debug bucket and removed public ACLs. Rate at the proxy has dropped by ~60% since block. Still seeing some replay attempts from new IPs.

leah (security): I'll start rotation now. Steps I'm executing: 1) create new key version in KMS 2) generate new service key and store in vault 3) trigger config rollout for dedicated pools 4) monitor auth success/failure metrics.

nicole (infra): Copying logs to quarantine now. ACLs removed. Retention reduced to 7 days for incident bucket. Kinesis stream for captured requests is live and limited to secops access.

sam (oncall): Open action list: [A] finish key rotation (leah) [B] complete canary validation and full rollout (jon) [C] customer notifications (ali) [D] preserve evidence and export logs to incident bucket (nicole) [E] run automated CVE/credentials scan across repos for accidental token commits (sam)

maya (oncall-backup): I'm coming on at 18:30 UTC — will take handoff if still active. Quick questions for the handoff: what's the current status of customer impact, and which tokens were revoked (IDs)? Please paste the final list before I take over.

sam (oncall): Current quick status for handoff: revoked tokens: svc-token-84217, svc-token-9f3b2, svc-token-cc44a. Canary rollout is in progress (5% traffic) and looks healthy so far. Two enterprise customers are impacted transiently; CS note drafting now. Evidence copied to s3://redwood-incident-quarantine/3123456789/. TTL shortened for new keys. Replay attempts declined but not gone.

leah (security): I'll stay on for the rotation completion and the initial audit trails. After rotation we should schedule a scoped postmortem and run pre-commit hook to catch debug log exposures.

ali (cust-success): Draft sent to account owners and CSMs; will post public status page update after legal + sec review.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-312345 created and assigned P2. Tickets: INC-312345 (internal), SEC-312345 (secops). Pager duty: sam -> maya at 18:30 UTC.

maya (oncall-backup): Acknowledge. I'll take over at shift change and continue monitoring rotation + customer comms. Will prepare a short incident summary for the postmortem board. :thumbsup: 

sam (oncall): Thanks team — I'll add timeline notes and full command history to the incident ticket before handoff. If anything spikes before 18:30 ping me in thread and I'll jump back in.

leah (security): One last note — preserve original logs for the forensic timeline; copy of quarantine should be a read-only snapshot for secops. I'll sign off after keys fully rotated and we have stable auth metrics.

sam (oncall): Handing off. Good work everyone.
